page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Above the text: running head "LIBER IV." with page number 463 at top right, a woodcut ornament (not transcribed), then the heading block. No margin notes. Catchword "Sed" at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.head: ORATIO III. CONCIO NATALIS EX Jesa. 9. habita
A BENIAMINE KOBERO Anno 1592
main_text.p: DIES hos festos, Auditores, in lætitia agita-re debebamus: quando universa Ecclesia memoriam nati ex virgine Servatoris, singulari religione celebrat, quod gaudium Angeli maximum ducebant humano generi. Sed ea est, (proh Deum Immortalem) temporum horum tristitia, à qua haud scio an revocare animos possit illius nuncii, quamvis optatissimi, recordatio. Quid e-nim dicam de cruentis & acerbissimis bellis, quæ contra pios in Belgio, in Galliis, in Pannonia & in conspectu Palatinatus nostri geruntur? quid de sectis detestabilibus, quæ per calumniam religio-nis, naturalem hominum conjunctionem diri-munt? Accedit quòd qui has pestilentissimas pe-stes vel armis vel voce avertere debebant, & pro sua fortitudine ac doctrinâ, Deo benè juvante poterant, illi diem suum obierunt; eorum verò vices, qui obire & tueri queât, vix aliq inveniûr.

page.notes: Page number "463" printed with a final figure resembling ȝ; read as 463. Possible doubtful readings: "pios" (contra pios), "inveniûr" (tilde over u), "aliq" (abbreviation as printed). The woodcut ornament above the heading is not transcribed.
